changes.text: With `onclick` (and no `href`), the card renders a stretched `<button type="button" class="overlay">` named by the title (or "Open"). The root is no longer `role="button"` with `tabindex="0"`, so the heading and `action` controls keep their own semantics and Enter/Space on a nested control no longer fires the card's `onclick`.
A titled card is `role="region"`, named by its title through `aria-labelledby`. An untitled card has no role and no label.
The overlay control shows a visible focus ring (`2px solid var(--ss-primary)`, inset) for both `href` and `onclick` cards.
`external` prop: with `href`, the overlay link opens in a new tab (`target="_blank"`, `rel="noopener noreferrer"`) and announces "(opens in a new tab)".
Cards with `href` no longer show a stray 1px primary line along the bottom edge: the overlay link cancels the global animated `a::before` underline from `theme.css`.
Styles ship in `dssoca/vanilla.css`, so the rendered `.ss-card` markup can be used on plain-HTML pages without Svelte.
The root class is `.ss-card` (was `.ss-panel`), and the header actions wrapper is a `.actions` element instead of an inline-styled `<div>`.
`footer` and `media` snippets: a `.foot` band mirroring the head, and a full-bleed `.media` area above it.
`href` and `onclick` make the whole card a link or a clickable surface through a stretched overlay, with `action` and `footer` controls kept clickable above it.
`variant` prop (`outlined` default, or `elevated`, which uses `--ss-shadow-1` and `--ss-shadow-2` on hover).
`description` prop for muted text under the heading, and `title` also accepts a Snippet for inline icons or badges. The head now renders when any of `title`, `meta`, `description` or `action` is set.
The card is labelled by its title: the root gets `aria-labelledby` pointing at the generated title id.
Styles are scoped inside the component instead of living in the global `theme.css`. The inner classes are now `.head` and `.body` (were `.ss-panel-head` and `.ss-panel-body`).
`size` prop (`sm`, `md`, `lg`), rendered as `data-size-variant` on the root; it inherits the global size when unset.
The title has heading semantics (`role="heading"`), with a new `titleLevel` prop for its `aria-level` (default `3`).
Class prefix renamed from `hub-` to `ss-`: the markup is `.ss-panel`, `.ss-panel-head` and `.ss-panel-body` (was `.hub-panel…`).
New component: a bordered panel with an optional header (`title`, `meta` and an `action` snippet) around its content.
